response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced software craftsman with strong distributed-systems, testing, and open-source geospatial (GIS) exposure through GISCollective, but his recent professional work has centered on TypeScript/Node.js full-stack and web platforms rather than modern C++ or Rust. His C++ experience is dated (2014-2015, National Instruments) and he has no evident Rust background, and no direct routing/navigation pipeline or tiling experience despite the GIS overlap, making him a partial but risky fit for this C++/Rust-centric routing tiles role.
strengths: Deep, long-standing interest and hands-on work in geospatial/GIS platforms (GISCollective, Green Map)
Strong distributed-systems and low-latency experience (Dunnhumby, high-throughput microservices)
Demonstrated versatility across many languages/stacks and strong software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD)
concerns: Primary C++ experience is nearly a decade old and not the focus of recent roles
No mentioned Rust experience despite it being an acceptable alternative
No direct experience with routing engines, navigation guidance QA, or tile-generation pipelines

key_factors.factor: Lack of recent/production C++ or Rust work
No direct routing/navigation tiling pipeline experience
Relevant geospatial/GIS background and distributed systems skills
